title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
title_zh: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据
authors: Anna Stansbury, Kyra Rodriguez
official: 卷期日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.
abstract_zh: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业发展研究或精英职业领域多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措的关注焦点。那么，它是否应该被重视？本文以美国终身教职制学术界这一职业为例，利用父母教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，揭示了职业发展中的显著阶级差距。与父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同届博士同学（来自同一院校和领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在R1研究型大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，其任职院校排名低11%，收入少3%，且工作满意度低5%。这一差距既非源于学术界的选择性退出，也非偏好差异所致；研究生产力的差异同样作用甚微。相反，文化资本和社会资本的差异是可能的驱动因素。此外，我们发现在产业界工作的博士群体中也存在职业发展的阶级差距，这表明该现象具有超越学术界的普遍性。

title: Manipulation-Robust Prediction
title_zh: 抗操纵预测
authors: Björkegren, Daniel, Blumenstock, Joshua E., Knight, Samsun
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的决策由机器学习算法指导。然而，当具有重大影响的决策被编码为算法时，个体可能会策略性地改变自身行为以达成预期结果。本文开发了一种实证方法，通过调整决策算法来预判操纵行为。通过明确建模操纵动机，我们的方法能够产生即使在完全透明规则下也能在操纵中保持稳定的决策规则。我们通过在肯尼亚开展的大规模实地实验对该方法进行了压力测试。实施结果表明，线性策略稳健决策规则的表现优于LASSO等标准线性模型。

title: The Asymmetric Incidence of Business Taxes: Survey Evidence from German Firms
title_zh: 企业税负的非对称影响：来自德国企业的调查证据
authors: Winter, Richard, Doerrenberg, Philipp, Eble, Fabian, Rostum-Afschar, Davud, Voget, Johannes
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We provide novel evidence on the incidence of business taxes using comprehensive survey and experimental data from German firms. Managers respond asymmetrically to randomized hypothetical tax changes of opposite signs, consistent with asymmetric profit tax incidence. They indicate that tax cuts would be primarily passed on to workers and used for investment projects, while tax increases would be shifted to consumers via higher prices and absorbed by firm owners via lower profit distributions. We further show that the stated incidence on workers rises with the absolute size of the tax change, partially offsetting the burden borne by firm owners.
abstract_zh: 我们利用德国企业的综合调查与实验数据，提供了关于商业税归宿的新证据。管理者对随机设定的正负向税收变化表现出非对称反应，这与利润税的非对称归宿特征一致。他们指出，减税将主要转嫁给劳动者并用于投资项目，而增税则会通过提高价格转嫁给消费者，并通过降低利润分配由企业主承担。我们进一步发现，税收变化绝对规模越大，劳动者承担的税负比例越高，这在一定程度上抵消了企业主所承受的负担。

title: The Power of Persistence: How Demand Shocks and Monetary Policy Shape Macroeconomic Outcomes
title_zh: 持续的力量：需求冲击与货币政策如何塑造宏观经济结果
authors: Fabrice Collard, Patrick Feve, Philipp Wangner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does a more persistent demand shock always generate a larger output response? Conventional wisdom says yes: forward-looking agents front-load spending in anticipation of higher lifetime resources, and the more lasting the shock, the stronger the expansion. This paper shows that this logic fails in New Keynesian models with an active monetary policy. The interplay between persistence and monetary policy stance governs a fundamental trade-off between two opposing forces: a permanent income channel that amplifies output, and a real interest rate channel that dampens it. Their balance generates three monetary policy regimes. In the empirically relevant intermediate regime, the output multiplier is hump-shaped in persistence.
abstract_zh: 更持久的需求冲击是否总会带来更大的产出响应？传统观点认为如此：前瞻性主体会因预期到终身资源增加而提前支出，且冲击持续时间越长，扩张效应越强。本文证明，在实施积极货币政策的凯恩斯模型中，这一逻辑并不成立。冲击持久性与货币政策立场之间的相互作用，主导着两种对立力量之间的根本权衡：放大产出的永久收入渠道与抑制产出的实际利率渠道。两者的平衡产生了三种货币政策体制。在具有经验相关性的中间体制中，产出乘数随持久性呈现驼峰形变化。

title: Navigating Geopolitical Risk: Evidence from U.S. Mutual Funds
title_zh: 驾驭地缘政治风险：来自美国共同基金的证据
authors: Matteo Crosignani, Lina Han, Marco Macchiavelli
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firm-level geoeconomic risk can affect even broadly diversified mutual fund portfolios. We study U.S. export controls that restrict sales of cutting-edge technology to selected Chinese firms for national security reasons. The stock prices of affected domestic suppliers drop immediately after the policy introduction. Mutual funds holding these stocks experience increased volatility and lower returns. Fund managers respond by selling stocks of exporters to China, buying lottery-like stocks, and increasing portfolio concentration. While stock-picking and market-timing skills do not help, specialist and high-fee funds are better at navigating geoeconomic risk.

abstract: Bond yields react to macroeconomic surprises, but the magnitude of this responsiveness depends on macroeconomic forecast disagreement and monetary policy uncertainty. Using intraday responses of US Treasury futures to surprises in macroeconomic data releases, we find that greater forecast disagreement about an economic indicator prior to its release dampens the yield curve response, while higher monetary policy uncertainty amplifies it. title: Resisting Populism through Financial Market Exposure: Experimental Evidence from Brexit
title_zh: 通过金融市场暴露抵制民粹主义：来自英国脱欧的实验证据
authors: Saumitra Jha
official: 官方在线 2026-06-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Populism has been on the rise, posing a threat to liberal democracy. Existing evidence suggests that globalization, economic shocks, and concerns over cultural change increase support for populist agendas. Yet less is known about interventions that can empower individuals to critically evaluate populist messaging. We argue that tailored exposure to financial markets can reduce support for populist policies because it can encourage learning about the gains of economic complementarity and the costs of nativism and isolationism. We test this argument with an RCT implemented in the run-up to the Brexit referendum. We randomly assigned British citizens to hold and trade complementary financial assets from the UK, EU and the US for six weeks. We show that this intervention increased citizens’ willingness to vote to remain in the European Union during the Brexit Referendum, and particularly so when exposed to companies that exemplify EU-UK economic complementarity. Countering populist narratives, treated participants instead came to associate the EU with economic prosperity, rather than a threat to their cultural identity or a waste of money. Overall, the effects are stronger among swing participants and those originally more open to a European cultural identity.
abstract_zh: 民粹主义持续抬头，对自由民主制度构成威胁。现有证据表明，全球化、经济冲击以及对文化变迁的担忧会增强民众对民粹主义议程的支持。然而，关于哪些干预措施能够帮助个人批判性评估民粹主义信息的研究仍显不足。本文认为，有针对性的金融市场参与能够降低民众对民粹主义政策的支持，因为这种参与可以促使人们认识到经济互补性的收益以及本土主义与孤立主义的代价。我们通过在英国脱欧公投前夕实施的一项随机对照试验验证了这一论点。我们随机分配英国公民在六周内持有并交易来自英国、欧盟和美国的互补性金融资产。研究表明，这一干预措施提高了民众在脱欧公投中投票支持留欧的意愿，尤其是当参与者接触体现欧盟-英国经济互补性的企业时效果更为显著。与民粹主义叙事相反，受试者转而将欧盟与经济繁荣相联系，而非视其为文化认同的威胁或资金浪费。总体而言，这种效应在摇摆参与者及原本对欧洲文化认同持更开放态度的人群中更为显著。
